title: Games resume after the DTRA contract ends: an SF86 request puts his clearance in 'undefined'

tellings.quote: And this just happened to me in contact in the desert. I was using my security clearance last June.

plain: A former government contractor named Dylan Borland says that after his contract with the Defense Threat Reduction Agency, a Pentagon agency that deals with weapons of mass destruction, ended, the strange treatment he had faced before started again. He says that last June, while using his security clearance, he was asked to fill out an SF86, the standard form for a government security clearance, and his clearance was then left marked 'undefined'. He tells it as something that happened to him first-hand.
